title: Bridging Fairness and Environmental Sustainability in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) tests 6-8, Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) tests 6-8 and Heilman Double Bind tests, Bias-STS (comparing similarity of stereotypical vs. counter-stereotypical sentence pairs with gendered and profession terms), and Bias-NLI (measuring neutral class predictions on template-based premise-hypothesis pairs).
Evaluated using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) tests 3-5, Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) tests 3-5, and the SEAT Angry Black Woman Stereotype test.
Evaluated using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) test 10 and Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) test 10.
Evaluated using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) test 9 and Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) test 9.
